Review (Curated.com expert): The Abstract is an extremely fun board for a solid intermediate to advanced park rider. Pop performance: Hitting jumps was really fun on this board, and the more I put into my ollies, the more pop I got out of it. 124. Groomer performance: I had a great time riding groomers on the Abstract. I felt like it could carve well and hold pretty good speed. It isn't the board to point straight down and race your friends on, but it is fun on groomers. 125. Turn initiation: Being a slightly softer freestyle board, I found this board to be very nimble and playful at slower speeds. I could turn quickly and spin easily while riding through the park. 126. Park performance: This is a park board. It was so much fun in the park. It is a true twin with solid and durable base for rails and boxes. 127. Value for money: The Arbor Relapse is a little bit cheaper, but overall I think the Abstract is at a very average price point for a board like this. 128.
